---
title: "3. Meet the inputs: Synthetic practice"
---

## Your task

Locate the three TSV files in `data/example/`.

## The three files

| File | Required structure |
|---|---|
| `feature-counts.tsv` | `feature_id`, followed by sample columns of nonnegative integer counts |
| `sample-metadata.tsv` | `sample_id` and `group`, with one row per sample |
| `taxonomy.tsv` | `feature_id` and `taxon`, with one row per feature |

## Dataset details

All features are fictional. A label identifies a teaching feature, not a real organism.

## Before continuing

Choose one sample ID and locate it in both counts and metadata. Choose one feature ID and locate it in both counts and taxonomy. These identifiers connect the files.
